notes.general_comments:
Generally the work seen was neat and well presented. Some candidates are still not obeying the instruction
to give answers to 3 significant figures. The easier questions proved to be 1, 3 and 4(i), while the harder
questions proved to be 2(i), 4(ii), 5(ii) and 6(i).
Again it is necessary to remind candidates to use the formula booklet provided.
The use of g = 9.8/9.81 was very rarely seen.
